title: Hexsweeper Lab
note: Dormant prior art: experimental skins over core.js. The five-theme flat game lives at play.html (Light / Dark / Fire / Plague / Escape; Water demoted to ?mode=water + collection) — not this catalog.

skins.name: Classic Neumorph
skins.ogDescription: A minimalist take on old school Minesweeper, with raised neumorphic cells and hex geometry that keeps surprising you.
skins.blurb: Original soft raised honeycomb — the control sample.

skins.name: Particle Bloom
skins.ogDescription: Classic Minesweeper with an ambient dust field that bursts into seed particles whenever you reveal a cell.
skins.blurb: Ambient dust field; cells burst seed particles on reveal.

skins.name: Glass Magnifier
skins.ogDescription: Old school Minesweeper seen through frostpane glass and a cursor-following magnifier over the hex grid.
skins.blurb: Frostpane tokens + cursor-following glass lens with radial distortion.

skins.name: Parallax Rings
skins.ogDescription: Classic Minesweeper with ring depth and pointer parallax that tilts the honeycomb as you hunt mines.
skins.blurb: Lab copy of ring-depth + pointer parallax. Production Fire mode lives in play.html.

skins.name: Brass Plaque
skins.ogDescription: A warm ceramic-metal desk take on Minesweeper, with brass finish tokens and hexagonal surprises under each cover.
skins.blurb: Finish tokens from materials/brass — warm ceramic-metal desk.

skins.name: Frostpane Night
skins.ogDescription: Old school Minesweeper behind dark frosted glass, with cyan-violet glow and translucent hex faces.
skins.blurb: Dark frosted glass: cyan–violet glow, translucent faces, rim light.

skins.name: Paper Relief
skins.ogDescription: Classic Minesweeper embossed on cream paper stock, with soft shadows and tactile hex geometry.
skins.blurb: Paper-systems cream stock with multi-shadow emboss depth.

skins.name: Comet Void
skins.ogDescription: Minesweeper in void black with ember sparks and meteor streaks threading through the hex grid.
skins.blurb: Shader-comet palette: void black, ember sparks, meteor streaks.

skins.name: Mycelium Web
skins.ogDescription: Classic Minesweeper where hyphal links grow between revealed cells and nutrient particles flow through the hexes.
skins.blurb: Hyphal links grow between revealed cells; nutrient particles flow.

skins.name: Caustic Lens
skins.ogDescription: Old school Minesweeper with under-board light caustics and a hover refraction bulge over each hex.
skins.blurb: Under-board light caustics + hover refraction bulge.
